title: Choose the visual world for Senro.AI Dashboard
question: The roll assigned Archival Intelligence Index. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Archival Intelligence Index
options.thesis: Competitor changes are framed as archived historical artifacts on a precise timeline.
options.viewport: Navigation on the left; the main area is a vertical timeline of changes framed like museum artifact cards.
options.risk: Might feel too academic or quiet for a fast-moving operational team.

raised.raise: Adopts the dense grid-alignment of pro tools for data readability.

options.label: Financial Terminal
options.thesis: Treats competitor updates as urgent market signals.
options.viewport: Dense tabular views with strict hierarchy, distinct red/green signal indicators.
options.risk: Familiar to the point of blending in with standard fintech dashboards.

options.label: Data-dense Pro Tool
options.thesis: A dense, high-contrast dashboard built for rapid scanning.
options.viewport: Top command bar, dense cards for each competitor event.
options.case: Serves the dashboard use case perfectly; loses narrowly on conceptual distinctness.
options.risk: Risks looking like typical AI SaaS slop if the gradients slip in.

options.label: Industrial Cockpit
options.case: Fuses poorly: too mechanical for a strategic intelligence tool.
options.kept: Strict use of mono typography for timestamps and raw data points.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, white cards on a light grey background.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
